if: the supply is a supply of services under forward charge
then: this limb yields the date on which the RECIPIENT shows the receipt of services in his books of account
note: Expressly conditional on (a) and (b) not applying. It is the only limb of s.13(2) that looks at the recipient's records rather than the supplier's.

evidence.quote: the date on which the recipient shows the receipt of services in his books of account, in a case where the provisions of clause (a) or clause (b) do not apply
